product.name: WE-W200 Professional Weather Station
product.manufacturer: Hainan World Electronic Science And Technology Co., Ltd.
product.description: All-in-one weather monitoring station with wind speed, direction, rainfall, and solar radiation sensors. Supports 4G and LoRa data transmission with IP67 housing.
product.lead: A professional-grade weather station for precision agriculture, meteorology, and environmental monitoring. Measures wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and solar radiation with high-accuracy sensors.
product.og_description: All-in-one weather station with 7 environmental sensors and dual 4G/LoRa connectivity.

highlights.title: 7-in-1 Environmental Sensing
highlights.text: Wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and solar radiation all in a single compact station.

highlights.title: Dual 4G & LoRa
highlights.text: Connect via 4G LTE (MQTT/HTTP) or LoRa up to 5km range. Choose your preferred backhaul for any deployment location.

highlights.title: Solar Powered
highlights.text: Built-in 20W solar panel with 12,000mAh backup battery for true off-grid operation, 365 days a year.

highlights.title: Industrial Durability
highlights.text: IP67-rated enclosure with UV-resistant coating. Operates reliably from -40°C to +85°C in extreme environments.

highlights.title: GNSS Positioning
highlights.text: Integrated GPS/GLONASS/BDS for automatic geo-tagging of weather data across distributed sensor networks.

highlights.title: Cloud Platform
highlights.text: WEST Cloud dashboard with real-time charts, alerts via email/SMS, and API access for third-party integration.

applications.title: Precision Agriculture
applications.text: Real-time microclimate monitoring for crop management. Optimize irrigation scheduling based on evapotranspiration data and wind conditions.

applications.title: Meteorological Networks
applications.text: Deploy dense networks of weather stations for hyper-local forecasting. LoRa backhaul enables wide-area coverage with low power consumption.
